verification.summary: 37 Taro/Vitest tests, 243 focused Python tests, 41 project-state tests and touched Python compilation passed at the candidate runtime head.

The isolated production package gate read the api.chickenbro.cloud immutable runtime-media manifest (release 2026-07-20-wow-icons-v1, 3,413 files) and proved the approved media root in both isolated package builds. Existing local dependency bytes were temporarily linked and removed; no dependency installation occurred.

A 144-file staged WeChat package compiled successfully with the isolated HTTPS candidate base embedded in common.js, then opened through the official DevTools CLI. Webpack reported only the pre-existing CSS order and size recommendations.

POST through the public candidate HTTPS path imported live hunter/marksmanship template build-projection:sha256:a15ba0f98d5e74a60baf8570a635fa5c57f37dd98465f42df8bfa55f26e4387f as verified: 15/15 slots have name or displayName and iconUrl; finger1, finger2, trinket1 and trinket2 each have complete trusted display facts.

smoke.summary: The isolated service returned the active Observed Build template list and a verified 15-slot community import through the public HTTPS candidate route. Candidate source hashes for community_template_import.py and postgres_cache_store.py matched the deployed runtime.

timerBackflow.summary: The candidate used PGOPTIONS default_transaction_read_only=on and WOW_NEWS_ENABLE_COLLECTORS=0. Production port 8787, public release pointers and sync/backfill timers were not restarted or changed.

candidateDeployment.rollback: Stop and remove wow-backend-runtime-media-community-import-display.service, delete its isolated candidate directory, and remove only the temporary nginx candidate location; production has not been modified.

runtimeEvidence.summary: Observed raw profile rows no longer flow directly to the public import response: resolver/release facts own name and displayName, and only missing iconUrl facts may be filled from a matching source=blizzard,status=verified registry row. Missing or conflicting registry facts remain blocked rather than guessed by the client.
The live candidate returned verified, no problems, 15 imported slots, complete names/display names and icon URLs for the real Zlex template.
The package contains the isolated candidate API base and has been opened in official DevTools for the frozen manual checks.

risks.detail: The real active candidate template now proves complete trusted display facts for all 15 imported gear rows, including rings and trinkets.
The user must still verify the candidate package on a real WeChat device before merge; package compilation and API smoke cannot substitute for that interaction.

cleanup.reason: The dedicated read-only candidate service, HTTPS route and local candidate worktree will be removed after the user accepts or rejects the manual test.
